decisions.statement: Every caller picking a wallpaper orders the personas by this rule.
The route answering the phone lands on the persona the desktop service lands on.
The persona messaged most recently comes first.
A tie is settled by the page id.
A persona with no wallpaper is passed over.
A persona with no slug is passed over.
A stamp nothing can read sorts behind every stamp something can read.

definition: the order personas are tried in when a wallpaper is picked
